critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Backend MO creation (server.py lines 3094-3106, 3228-3232) was failing for simplified routings because it expected routing.item_id. Fixed to get item from BOM's parent_item_id instead.
The create_wo_for_item helper function now accepts use_routing_id parameter for main MO, falls back to item_id lookup for child MOs (backward compatible).
seed_data_creation: Test items (FG, RM), supplier, BOM with operations, routing, production order, and work order created during testing with unique UUID suffixes for isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routing redesign complete: (1) Routings are now simple operation types (name/description/status only, no item_id or operations array). (2) Operations are defined at BOM level with sequence, operation_name, setup_time_minutes, run_time_minutes. (3) MO creation pulls operations from BOM's operations array. (4) UI: SC Done label shown for in_progress SC MOs, no Sub-Contract checkbox in Create MO dialog.

bug_fix_applied.description: MO creation was failing with 'Item not found for routing' error when using simplified routings (without item_id)
bug_fix_applied.root_cause: Backend code at lines 3094-3106 was looking for item via routing.get('item_id'), but simplified routings don't have item_id
bug_fix_applied.fix_description: Changed to get item from BOM's parent_item_id. Added use_routing_id parameter to create_wo_for_item for main MO routing lookup.
bug_fix_applied.verification_status: VERIFIED - MO creation now works with simplified routings
